title: Understanding Mean Cubed Error
text: The Mean Cubed Error is defined as (1/n)*sum{i extbackslash=1}{n}{(y_i-y extunderscore i extasciicircum 3)}. Consider how this differs from Mean Squared Error.

title: Behavior of Cubic Functions
text: Cubic functions can have different properties compared to quadratic functions. Think about how the cube of a number behaves differently from the square of a number.

title: Minimizing the Loss Function
text: Consider how the loss function behaves as the predicted value approaches the actual value. What happens to the loss as the difference between $$y_i$$ and $$y$$ extunderscore i approaches zero?

title: Analyzing the Derivative
